page.title: Optional Extras — full flag adjudication
page.standfirst_html:
The last Wave 2 pass. Optional Extras is the seven-part mathematics-and-charts appendix, and its 47% clean rate is not a prose day's 47%: three artifact classes that barely exist elsewhere — MathJax set against pdftotext's mangled symbols, chart axis-tick numerals lifted into the running text, and those numerals landing inside a hyphen line-wrap — account for about 160 of the 214 near-certain flags on their own. They are cleared here as classes rather than one at a time.

What is left is not small. 89 proposed fixes, and the defect density in this appendix is higher than any day of the wave: a reversed sentence (“The writing is not very clear” became “The writing on it was very clear”), a source sentence dropped mid-argument, a clause replaced by one that appears nowhere in the source, a citation into Out of the Crisis pointing nine pages wrong, and several coinages — autogroups, probability-momentous, top-sided — that are not words. Much of this reads as paraphrase rather than transcription.

Everything below cites the printed page. Three findings need a decision that is not simply apply: OE-102 (a repeated source typo the site already corrected, needing only a deviation entry), OE-92 (site-invented cross-reference labels), and OE-85 (a navigation line absent from the site with nothing recording why).
